name: io.github.Abdk4Moura/xats
description: One agent roster and inbox shared by Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Pi.

environmentVariables.name: XATS_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full MCP URL of a running xats daemon. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:9100/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: XATS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of a running xats daemon when XATS_MCP_URL is unset. Default 9100.
